name: YOLOWeeds
description: A benchmark dataset and evaluation suite for assessing YOLO object detectors on multi-class weed detection in cotton production systems.
evaluation_method: mAP (mean Average Precision), commonly reported as mAP@0.5
notes: Domain-specific agricultural dataset — may have class imbalance, seasonal/lighting variation, and limited-scale images; intended for non-LLM computer-vision evaluation (YOLO-focused).
